@protobuf__rpc.summary: Protobuf / gRPC RPC mapping for fields or entity object types.

authors.intro: Emitted by the protobuf loader. Pair with `@transport` for the gRPC endpoint.

implementers.compose: May rewrite mapping binds under renames.
implementers.runtime: Encode `args`, invoke `service`/`method`, decode `selection`. `stream: true` yields AsyncIterable; `entity: true` wires entity resolve.

subgraph.defaults: Optional locally; loaders usually stamp the subgraph name when composing.
subgraph.constraints: String subgraph name. When present, must match the owning Mesh subgraph / `@transport(subgraph:)` entry used at runtime.
subgraph.authors: Identify which Mesh subgraph owns this annotation when several sources are composed. Omit for single-source hand SDL if the loader will stamp it.
subgraph.implementers: Compose and join rewrites use `subgraph` to attribute directive apps. Transports filter apps by the active subgraph. Never invent a second name for the same source.

service.defaults: Optional in SDL; required for a real call.

method.defaults: Optional in SDL; required for a real call.

args.constraints: Compact GraphQL → protobuf request mapping with `$args` / `$this`.

entity.constraints: True to register as Mesh entity resolver on Query fields / OBJECT apps.
